title: The Star Zoo
intro: At night you sneaked aboard an old interplanetary zoo ship parked at the edge of a dark planet. The hatch hissed shut behind you, and a calm voice announced: automatic launch in one hour. Find a way to open the airlock before the Star Zoo takes you to the stars.
winText: The airlock wheel spins, the hatch swings open and cool night air rolls in. You step out under the two moons. Behind you the little robot waves goodbye, and the jelly creature flashes all its colours at once.

do.say: Jars with labels from far-off worlds: a pickled star-snail, a jar of humming moss, a sock of unknown origin.
A maintenance chart for the tool rack: two rows of four little lamps, some lit, some dark. "Set the switches like this to open".

hotspots.label: Switch panel
hotspots.hint: The chart next to the rack shows which switches must be on.

do.say: A grabber on a long telescopic pole. Good for things out of reach.
Spanners for bolts that do not exist on Earth.

hotspots.label: Glowing fruit
hotspots.fail: A glowing orange fruit hangs at the very top of the vine, far out of reach.
hotspots.hint: Something on the tool rack can reach that high.

do.say: The grabber snaps shut around the fruit. It is warm and smells of pears and thunderstorms.
A curly alien vine in a glass tube of bubbling water. It hums softly.

hotspots.label: Jelly creature
hotspots.fail: A wobbly jelly creature sits on something that glows under it. It stares at you with hungry eyes and will not move.
hotspots.hint: The creature is hungry. Something on the planter looks tasty.

do.say: Gulp! The creature swallows the fruit, oozes into the corner and starts flashing colours. It was sitting on an energy cell.
You reach through the little hatch and take the energy cell. It buzzes in your hand.

hotspots.label: Jelly creature
hotspots.hint: Watch the creature: after each bright white flash it shows four colours in a row.

do.say: After every bright white flash the creature shows the same four colours, one after another.

hotspots.label: Colour lock
hotspots.hint: Four colour wheels. Somebody in this room changes colour all the time.

do.say: Inside: half of a key card and the ship's logbook.
Packing straw and one lonely space sock.

hotspots.label: Robot
hotspots.fail: A little maintenance robot on a rail. Its battery slot is empty and one lamp blinks sadly.
hotspots.hint: The robot needs an energy cell. Something in the room is sitting on one.

do.say: The robot beeps, its eyes light up and it rolls along the rail to the navigation console.

hotspots.label: Planet buttons
hotspots.hint: The console wants the ship's route. Someone in the room knows it.

do.say: Six buttons with planets on them. A sign says: ENTER ROUTE. You have no idea which route.

hotspots.label: Planet buttons
hotspots.hint: Press the planets in the order of the route in the robot's hologram.

do.say: The robot projects a glowing map: the ship's route through four worlds.
The other half of the key card.
Empty, apart from a star-shaped paperclip.
Outside: the dark planet the ship is parked on, a huge ringed world in the sky and two little moons.

hotspots.label: Card slot
hotspots.fail: A card slot and a keypad. The airlock will not even listen to you without a key card.
hotspots.hint: The airlock needs a whole key card. Its halves are hidden in two places.

do.say: The card slides in and the keypad lights up: ENTER DOCKING CODE.

hotspots.label: Keypad
hotspots.hint: Every planet in the logbook has its own docking code. Look out of the porthole to see where you are.

grabber.name: Grabber
grabber.text: A grabber on a long telescopic pole.

fruit.name: Glowing fruit
fruit.text: Warm, glowing and smells of pears and thunderstorms.

card_a.name: Left card half
card_a.text: The left half of a key card.

combine.text: The two halves click together into one key card.

card_b.name: Right card half
card_b.text: The right half of a key card.

card.name: Key card
card.text: The airlock key card, whole again.

log.name: Ship's logbook
log.text: The ship's logbook. One page lists docking codes for four planets.

route.name: Route hologram
route.text: The ship's route: 1 Earth, 2 a comet, 3 a moon, 4 a ringed planet.

do.say: Click, click, clunk: the tool rack unlocks and swings open. A grabber hangs inside.
The crate lid pops open with a hiss.
ROUTE CONFIRMED. A little drawer slides out of the console.
DOCKING CODE ACCEPTED. The big wheel on the hatch begins to turn.
